description: Use this when the user wants App Store listing art (an animated product page header, a search result, In-App Event art) or a marketing image (a launch post for X, LinkedIn or Instagram, a link preview, a Play feature graphic) designed for their app and you will draw it yourself. Returns the appdesigns recipe for that asset as markdown: its size and what crops or covers it, the layer format create_design takes (phone frames included), the moves, the quality bar and the hand-off to the user. Read-only; changes nothing.

asset.description: The asset, as create_design names it: header, search_result, event_card, event_page, x_post, linkedin_post, link_preview, instagram_square, instagram_portrait, instagram_tall, product_hunt, wide_image or play_feature_graphic.
